verdict.rationale: Undermind's own materials say users can 'trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper', and that workspace notes, syntheses and reports carry citations linking back to source papers. A community user adds that it reliably returns references, unlike a general LLM. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of citation granularity and coverage (whether every claim is cited), and independent hands-on confirmation of in-line, claim-level citations rather than ranked reference lists.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: Trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper
Citations link back to the source papers, and files stay available to agents across sessions.
Claude is reluctant to give references unless coaxed, while Undermind solves this.
